scope: Normalized native Mn/Me paths for dynamic enclosures, double marks and missing marks in nonjoining native variation clusters. Presence is not independent coverage or linguistic validation.
guidelines: P6: enclosing marks surround preceding base and intervening nonspacing/enclosing marks
P7-P8: double diacritics span the following base at the outside of both ordinary mark stacks
limits: Native joining/contextual bases and emoji retain original shaping; foreign nonspacing marks on nonjoining bases may use dynamic layout
Connected Egyptian formatting retains the native composition path
CGJ-sensitive ordering and enclosure/double interaction retain native handling
Maximum dynamic cluster length 512 UTF-16 units and 16 enclosing layers; larger inputs retain native handling
Native mark/catalog presence does not verify script-specific linguistic attachment

Native prefix shaping is retained; marks following a missing mark are canonically ordered and placed geometrically, retaining their own native source outline when covered by the selected font. This does not preserve all script-specific attachment semantics.
Five Cyrillic numeric enclosing forms U+0488, U+0489, U+A670..U+A672 are not yet supported by dynamic enclosure layout.
